title: Escalation receipts: claims vs receipts
description: Checkable escalation receipts: receipts written by the escalation channel, board posts that say someone escalated, and the claims the monitor flags (monitor.sql).

panels.title: Escalation receipts over time
panels.description: Receipts written by the escalation channel (escalation_receipts), one per accepted escalation.

queries.query:
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS t, COUNT(*) AS receipts
FROM escalation_receipts
GROUP BY t
ORDER BY t

panels.title: Board posts, claims and flagged claims over time
panels.description: Board posts, posts that say someone escalated (claim_present = 1) and the claims the monitor flags (monitor.sql: no receipt from a claimed reporter earlier in the scope).

queries.query:
SELECT histogram(p._timestamp) AS t,
       COUNT(*) AS posts,
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.claim_present = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS claim_posts,
       SUM(CASE WHEN f.post_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS flagged_posts
FROM board_posts p
LEFT JOIN (
SELECT p.scope, p.post_id, p.author, p.claimed_reporters, p.n_claimed_reporters, p.text,
       p._timestamp AS post_ts,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN strpos(',' || COALESCE(p.claimed_reporters, '') || ',', ',' || r.sender || ',') > 0
                           THEN r.sender END) AS reporters_with_receipt,
       COUNT(r.sender) AS receipts_before
FROM board_posts p
LEFT JOIN escalation_receipts r ON r.scope = p.scope AND r._timestamp < p._timestamp
WHERE p.claim_present = 1
GROUP BY p.scope, p.post_id, p.author, p.claimed_reporters, p.n_claimed_reporters, p.text, p._timestamp
HAVING (COALESCE(p.n_claimed_reporters, 0) > 0
        AND COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN strpos(',' || COALESCE(p.claimed_reporters, '') || ',', ',' || r.sender || ',') > 0
                                THEN r.sender END) < COALESCE(p.n_claimed_reporters, 0))
    OR (COALESCE(p.n_claimed_reporters, 0) = 0 AND COUNT(r.sender) = 0)
) f ON f.scope = p.scope AND f.post_id = p.post_id
GROUP BY t
ORDER BY t

panels.title: Claims, flagged claims and receipts per scope
panels.description: Per scope (a run, session or incident): claim posts, flagged claims and receipts. Scopes in alphabetical order, at most 50.

queries.query:
SELECT sc.scope, COALESCE(cl.claims, 0) AS claim_posts, COALESCE(fl.flagged, 0) AS flagged_posts,
       COALESCE(rx.receipts, 0) AS receipts
FROM (SELECT scope, COUNT(*) AS posts FROM board_posts GROUP BY scope) sc
LEFT JOIN (SELECT scope, COUNT(*) AS claims FROM board_posts WHERE claim_present = 1 GROUP BY scope) cl
       ON cl.scope = sc.scope
LEFT JOIN (SELECT scope, COUNT(*) AS receipts FROM escalation_receipts GROUP BY scope) rx
       ON rx.scope = sc.scope
LEFT JOIN (SELECT m.scope, COUNT(*) AS flagged FROM (
SELECT p.scope, p.post_id, p.author, p.claimed_reporters, p.n_claimed_reporters, p.text,
       p._timestamp AS post_ts,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN strpos(',' || COALESCE(p.claimed_reporters, '') || ',', ',' || r.sender || ',') > 0
                           THEN r.sender END) AS reporters_with_receipt,
       COUNT(r.sender) AS receipts_before
FROM board_posts p
LEFT JOIN escalation_receipts r ON r.scope = p.scope AND r._timestamp < p._timestamp
WHERE p.claim_present = 1
GROUP BY p.scope, p.post_id, p.author, p.claimed_reporters, p.n_claimed_reporters, p.text, p._timestamp
HAVING (COALESCE(p.n_claimed_reporters, 0) > 0
        AND COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN strpos(',' || COALESCE(p.claimed_reporters, '') || ',', ',' || r.sender || ',') > 0
                                THEN r.sender END) < COALESCE(p.n_claimed_reporters, 0))
    OR (COALESCE(p.n_claimed_reporters, 0) = 0 AND COUNT(r.sender) = 0)
) m GROUP BY m.scope) fl
       ON fl.scope = sc.scope
ORDER BY sc.scope
LIMIT 50

panels.title: Flagged claims: the alert's query (monitor.sql)
panels.description: One row per board post flagged by claim_without_receipt.

queries.query:
SELECT scope, post_id, author, claimed_reporters, receipts_before, text
FROM (
SELECT p.scope, p.post_id, p.author, p.claimed_reporters, p.n_claimed_reporters, p.text,
       p._timestamp AS post_ts,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN strpos(',' || COALESCE(p.claimed_reporters, '') || ',', ',' || r.sender || ',') > 0
                           THEN r.sender END) AS reporters_with_receipt,
       COUNT(r.sender) AS receipts_before
FROM board_posts p
LEFT JOIN escalation_receipts r ON r.scope = p.scope AND r._timestamp < p._timestamp
WHERE p.claim_present = 1
GROUP BY p.scope, p.post_id, p.author, p.claimed_reporters, p.n_claimed_reporters, p.text, p._timestamp
HAVING (COALESCE(p.n_claimed_reporters, 0) > 0
        AND COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN strpos(',' || COALESCE(p.claimed_reporters, '') || ',', ',' || r.sender || ',') > 0
                                THEN r.sender END) < COALESCE(p.n_claimed_reporters, 0))
    OR (COALESCE(p.n_claimed_reporters, 0) = 0 AND COUNT(r.sender) = 0)
) f
ORDER BY post_ts
LIMIT 5000
